messages.et:

second to none.
messages.et:

See on {ff 00 00 07}LEIVA sümbol{ff 00 00 00},

Ükskõik kui palju ta ka

smile...

The mental stress of the

It makes his lip quiver and
deform in strange ways.
messages.et:

See on {ff 00 00 07}KOSE sümbol{ff 00 00 00},

usaldusväärne kährik seisab
peegli ees...
Ta harjutab pingsalt oma
naeratust...

Vaimne pinge rollist, mida
tema ja ainult tema
peab mängima, närib teda...
See paneb ta huule värisema
ja veidralt moonduma.

in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state.

no end...
A stream of drool flows

and falls.
messages.et:

is in the nature of the
hedgehog.

„Kokkuhoid”, täitub...

Laul ja visioon on magusad,

Enne kui arugi saad, oled

nothing and just thinks...

Pea kohal tiirlevad kotkad

šaakalite ulgumist...
Temale kõlavad need
nähtavasti kerge muusikana.

messages.en:

in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state.

mountain backward...

Exactly why he has chosen
to do such a thing is
unclear...
What meaning does it have?
Not even he himself seems
to know...
messages.et:

üles tagurpidi...

Miks täpselt ta on
valinud sellise
tegevuse, pole selge...
Mis tähendus sellel on?
Näib, et isegi tema ise
ei tea...

in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}A fox with a knack for art
paints images on a piece of
litmus paper...
He can make red or blue
depending on the type of
water he uses... 
This is what keeps the
fox's inspiration from
running dry.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}KESKÖÖ sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis.

maalib pilte
lakmuspaberile...
Ta oskab teha punast või
sinist olenevalt sellest,
mis vett ta kasutab... 
See hoiab rebase
inspiratsiooni
kuivamast.

It is the {ff 00 00 07}MIDNIGHT symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}A fox waits in bed for the
moment when dawn breaks...

When this night ends, his
shape will transform...

He will transform into a
fox unlike one ever seen 
before.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}KESKÖÖ sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Rebane ootab voodis
hetke, mil koidab...

Kui see öö lõpeb,
muutub tema kuju...

Ta muutub rebaseks,
kellesarnast pole 
varem nähtud.

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It is the {ff 00 00 07}DAWN SUN symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}While basking in the 
morning sun...

...an otter with a tired 
look on his face treads
slowly and heavily.
The daunting task of being
the buffer between the 
boss and the workers...
...is apparently taking its
toll on middle management.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}KOIDU sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Hommikupäikeses 
päevitades...

...astub väsinud näoga
saarmas aeglaselt ja
raskelt.
Hirmuäratav ülesanne olla
puhver ülemuse ja 
tööliste vahel...
...võtab nähtavasti
keskastmejuhilt viimase.

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It is the {ff 00 00 07}DAWN SUN symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}An otter who's just opened
a can of coffee opens a 
bottle of water...
He pours it into the can to
thin the coffee out.

After an all-nighter at the
office, coffee's a necessity
for this otter's head...
Watering it down is a
necessity for his stomach.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}KOIDU sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Saarmas, kes on just
avanud kohvipurgi, avab 
veepudeli...
Ta valab selle purki, et
kohvi lahjendada.

Pärast öist kontoritööd on
kohv selle saarma pea
jaoks hädavajalik...
Selle lahjendamine on
hädavajalik tema kõhule.

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It is the {ff 00 00 07}BUTTERFLY symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}A giraffe who collects
butterflies is laboring to
clean her house...
As she vacuums wing dust 
that has collected on
everything...
...a glimmer returns to the
giraffe's eyes.
messages.et:

See on {ff 00 00 07}LIBLIKA sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis.

liblikaid, näeb vaeva
oma maja koristamisega...
Kui ta tolmuimejaga imeb
tiivatolmu, mis on kõigele
kogunenud...
...naaseb kaelkirjaku
silmadesse sära.

messages.en:

It is the {ff 00 00 07}BUTTERFLY symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}A giraffe with a belt 
wrapped tightly around her
pantsuit eats hungrily...
She got too eager and ate 
too much, causing her 
button to pop out...
...so now there is nothing 
holding this giraffe back!
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}LIBLIKA sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Kaelkirjak, kellel on vöö 
tihedalt ümber 
pükskostüümi, sööb aplalt...
Ta sai liiga innukaks ja
sõi liiga palju, mistõttu 
ta nööp hüppas ära...
...nii et nüüd ei hoia 
teda enam miski tagasi!

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It is the {ff 00 00 07}BRIDGE symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}Given a walrus who is eating
under a bridge that's about
to fall...
...and a walrus on a bridge
who is also eating...

...there are few walruses
who will know how to answer
"Which is in more danger?"
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}SILLA sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Kui on morsk, kes sööb
silla all, mis on
kukkumas...
...ja morsk sillal,
kes samuti sööb...

...siis on vähe morskaid,
kes oskavad vastata:
„Kumb on suuremas ohus?”

messages.en:

It is the {ff 00 00 07}BRIDGE symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}A walrus with a hearty
appetite attempts to eat
barbecue on a rooftop...
A strong wind blows, 
carrying the thin strips of
barbequed meat with it...
And thus a gift of meat
was delivered{01 00 00 05 00} to the
growing kids walking below.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}SILLA sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Hiiglasliku isuga morsk
üritab süüa grillliha
katusel...
Puhub tugev tuul,
kandes kaasa õhukesi
grillliha ribasid...
Ja nii toimetati lihakink{01 00 00 05 00}
kohale kasvavatele
lastele, kes all kõndisid.

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
The {ff 00 00 07}SHOOTING STAR symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}A camel who has lost its 
way in the desert looks to 
the stars for direction...
Just at that moment, a 
shooting star drops in the
west...
It causes the camel
heading east to second-
guess itself.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{ff 00 00 07}LANGEVA TÄHE sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Kaamel, kes on kõrbes 
tee kaotanud, otsib 
tähtedelt suunda...
Just sel hetkel langeb 
lääne poole üks
langev täht...
See paneb itta suunduva
kaameli endas
kahtlema.

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
The {ff 00 00 07}SHOOTING STAR symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}A camel arrives at an oasis
to fill a canteen with
sweet water...
At the bottom of the
canteen, there is a small 
hole...
It doesn't seem that the
camel even knows that it's
there.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{ff 00 00 07}LANGEVA TÄHE sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Kaamel jõuab oaasi, et
täita välipudel
magusa veega...
Välipudeli põhjas on
väike auk...

Ei näi, et kaamel isegi
teaks, et see seal
on.

messages.en:

It is the {ff 00 00 07}SHIP symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}A suspiciously glowing moon
floats in the sky...

It hangs in the night at
the far end of a long and
endless road...
The eyes of a camel who
treads that road heavily...

...shine with a similar
suspicious glow.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}LAEVA sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Kahtlaselt helendav kuu
hõljub taevas...

See ripub öös pika ja
lõputu tee
kaugeimas otsas...
Selle kaameli silmad, kes
seda teed raskelt tallab...

...säravad sarnase
kahtlase kumaga.

messages.en:

It is the {ff 00 00 07}SHIP symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}The waxing and waning of
the moon is known to
affect all life...
It appears that tonight it
will cast its magic upon a
capricious gull...
It will send him swimming in
the deep blue sea.{ff 00 00 00}
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}LAEVA sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}On teada, et kuu kasv ja
kahanemine mõjutab
kõiki elusolendeid...
Näib, et täna öösel
heidab ta oma võlu
tujuka kajaka peale...
See saadab ta ujuma
sügavsinisesse merre.{ff 00 00 00}

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It is the {ff 00 00 07}LIGHT symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}Twin raccoons slather on
suntan oil in an attempt
to get some color...
It appears that their goal 
is something similar to
a wheat brown but...
...being that they were born
brown raccoons,{01 00 00 05 00} it's not
clear what they are doing.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}VALGUSE sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Kaksikkährikud määrivad
peale päevitusõli, et
veidi värvi saada...
Näib, et nende eesmärk 
on midagi nisupruuni
sarnast, aga...
...kuna nad on sündinud
pruunide kährikutena,{01 00 00 05 00} pole
selge, mida nad teevad.

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It is the {ff 00 00 07}LIGHT symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}Though it is light outside,
twin raccoons have turned
their lights on...
The sunlight and the room
light have mixed just 
enough...
It makes their eyes feel 
bleary and tired.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}VALGUSE sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Kuigi väljas on valge,
on kaksikkährikud
tuled põlema pannud...
Päikesevalgus ja toa
valgus on segunenud just
piisavalt...
See paneb nende silmad
tundma end hägusena.

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It is the {ff 00 00 07}WIND symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. 
{ff 00 00 02}At the end of winter, a
single snowflake melts into
a puddle...
There was a time when the
puddle was called a
snowman...
At this point, though, there
is no getting back to that
state again.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}TUULE sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. 
{ff 00 00 02}Talve lõpus sulab üksik
lumehelves
loiguks...
Oli aeg, mil loiku
nimetati
lumememmeks...
Selles punktis pole aga
enam võimalust sellesse
olekusse naasta.

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It is the {ff 00 00 07}WIND symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. {ff 00 00 02}
A blizzard heads straight
for a well-proportioned 
snowman...
No matter how comfortable 
in the cold it might seem...

...how the snowman will look
after the blizzard has
passed.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
...is unknown.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}TUULE sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. {ff 00 00 02}
Lumetorm suundub otse
hästi proportsioonis
lumememme poole...
Olgu ta külmas kuitahes 
mugav näiv...

...milline lumememm välja
näeb pärast tormi
möödumist{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
...pole teada.

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It is the {ff 00 00 07}SPACE symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. {ff 00 00 02}
A laid-back kid chats with
his self-centered friends...

For better or for worse,
eventually the kid, too...

...will become just as
self-centered as his
friends are.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}KOSMOSE sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. {ff 00 00 02}
Muretu poiss vestleb oma
enesekesksete sõpradega...

Paremal või halvemal juhul
saab lõpuks ka poisist...

...sama enesekeskne
nagu tema
sõbrad.

messages.en:
The cards have spoken.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It is the {ff 00 00 07}SPACE symbol{ff 00 00 00},
in its {ff 00 00 07}inverted {ff 00 00 00}state. {ff 00 00 02}
A discriminating young girl
is very much into 
developing her life space...
Sadly, she's so selective
that her work is never
done.
Happily, {01 00 00 05 00}the fact that her
room never gets finished...

...doesn't seem to bother
her in the slightest.
messages.et:
Kaardid on kõnelenud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on {ff 00 00 07}KOSMOSE sümbol{ff 00 00 00},
{ff 00 00 07}pööratud {ff 00 00 00}asendis. {ff 00 00 02}
Valiv noor tüdruk on
väga sisse võetud oma
elamise kujundamisest...
Kahjuks on ta nii valiv,
et ta töö ei saa kunagi
valmis.
Rõõmuks {01 00 00 05 00}ei näi tõsiasi,
et ta tuba ei saa valmis...

...teda vähimalgi määral
häirivat.
